people.name: Chaldea

translations.web: You have moreover multiplied your prostitution to the land of merchants, to Chaldea; and yet you weren’t satisfied with this.
translations.bsb: So you extended your promiscuity to Chaldea, the land of merchants—but even with this you were not satisfied!
translations.kjv: Thou hast moreover multiplied thy fornication in the land of Canaan unto Chaldea; and yet thou wast not satisfied herewith.
translations.asv: Thou hast moreover multiplied thy whoredom unto the land of traffic, unto Chaldea; and yet thou wast not satisfied herewith.
